verses.original: אִ֭יּוֹב שְׂאֵ֥ת וַיֹּ֣סֶף מְשָׁל֗וֹ וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.literal: And Job . . . continued his discourse . . .

verses.original: מִֽי־ יִתְּנֵ֥נִי כְיַרְחֵי־ קֶ֑דֶם כִּ֝ימֵ֗י אֱל֣וֹהַּ יִשְׁמְרֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: mî- yit·tə·nê·nî ḵə·yar·ḥê- qe·ḏem kî·mê ’ĕ·lō·w·ah yiš·mə·rê·nî
verses.literal: How I long . . . for the months gone by for the days when God watched over me

verses.original: נֵ֭רוֹ בְּהִלּ֣וֹ עֲלֵ֣י רֹאשִׁ֑י לְ֝אוֹרוֹ אֵ֣לֶךְ חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.literal: when His lamp shone above my head and by His light I walked through the darkness

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר הָ֭יִיתִי בִּימֵ֣י חָרְפִּ֑י בְּס֥וֹד אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ עֲלֵ֣י אָהֳלִֽי׃
verses.literal: when I was vvv in my prime when the friendship of God rested on my tent

verses.original: שַׁ֭דַּי בְּע֣וֹד עִמָּדִ֑י נְעָרָֽי׃ סְבִ֖יבוֹתַ֣י
verses.literal: when the Almighty was still with me and my children were around me

verses.original: הֲלִיכַ֣י בִּרְחֹ֣ץ בְּחֵמָ֑ה וְצ֥וּר יָצ֥וּק עִ֝מָּדִ֗י פַּלְגֵי־ שָֽׁמֶן׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lî·ḵay bir·ḥōṣ bə·ḥê·māh wə·ṣūr yā·ṣūq ‘im·mā·ḏî pal·ḡê- šā·men
verses.literal: when my steps were bathed in cream and the rock poured out for me streams of oil

verses.original: בְּצֵ֣אתִי קָ֑רֶת שַׁ֣עַר עֲלֵי־ אָכִ֥ין מוֹשָׁבִֽי׃ בָּ֝רְח֗וֹב
verses.literal: When I went out to the city gate . . . and took my seat in the public square

verses.original: נְעָרִ֣ים רָא֣וּנִי וְנֶחְבָּ֑אוּ וִֽ֝ישִׁישִׁים קָ֣מוּ עָמָֽדוּ׃
verses.literal: the young men saw me and withdrew and the old men rose to their feet

verses.original: שָׂ֭רִים עָצְר֣וּ בְמִלִּ֑ים יָשִׂ֥ימוּ לְפִיהֶֽם׃ וְ֝כַ֗ף
verses.literal: The princes refrained from speaking and covered their mouths with their hands

verses.original: קוֹל־ נְגִידִ֥ים נֶחְבָּ֑אוּ וּ֝לְשׁוֹנָ֗ם דָּבֵֽקָה׃ לְחִכָּ֥ם
verses.transliteration: qō·wl- nə·ḡî·ḏîm neḥ·bā·’ū ū·lə·šō·w·nām dā·ḇê·qāh lə·ḥik·kām
verses.literal: The voices of the nobles were hushed and their tongues stuck to the roofs of their mouths

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֹ֣זֶן שָׁ֭מְעָה וַֽתְּאַשְּׁרֵ֑נִי וְעַ֥יִן רָ֝אֲתָ֗ה וַתְּעִידֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ō·zen šā·mə·ʿāh wat·tə·’aš·šə·rê·nî wə·‘a·yin rā·’ă·ṯāh wat·tə·‘î·ḏê·nî
verses.literal: For those who heard me called me blessed and those who saw me commended me

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אֲ֭מַלֵּט עָנִ֣י מְשַׁוֵּ֑עַ וְ֝יָת֗וֹם וְֽלֹא־ עֹזֵ֥ר לֽוֹ׃
verses.literal: because I rescued the poor who cried out and the fatherless who had no helper

verses.original: אֹ֭בֵד עָלַ֣י תָּבֹ֑א בִּרְכַּ֣ת אַלְמָנָ֣ה וְלֵ֖ב אַרְנִֽן׃
verses.literal: The dying man . . . . . . blessed me and I made the widow’s heart sing for joy

verses.original: לָ֭בַשְׁתִּי צֶ֣דֶק וַיִּלְבָּשֵׁ֑נִי מִשְׁפָּטִֽי׃ כִּֽמְעִ֥יל וְ֝צָנִ֗יף
verses.transliteration: lā·ḇaš·tî ṣe·ḏeq way·yil·bā·šê·nî miš·pā·ṭî kim·‘îl wə·ṣā·nîp̄
verses.literal: I put on righteousness and it clothed me justice was my robe and my turban

verses.original: הָ֭יִיתִי עֵינַ֣יִם לַֽעִוֵּ֑ר אָֽנִי׃ וְרַגְלַ֖יִם לַפִּסֵּ֣חַ
verses.literal: I [served as] eyes to the blind [and] as feet to the lame

verses.original: אָ֭נֹכִֽי אָ֣ב לָֽאֶבְיוֹנִ֑ים אֶחְקְרֵֽהוּ׃ וְרִ֖ב לֹא־ יָדַ֣עְתִּי
verses.literal: I was a father to the needy and I took up the case of the stranger . . .

verses.original: וָֽ֭אֲשַׁבְּרָה מְתַלְּע֣וֹת עַוָּ֑ל אַשְׁלִ֥יךְ טָֽרֶף׃ וּ֝מִשִּׁנָּ֗יו
verses.literal: I shattered the fangs of the unjust and snatched the prey from his teeth

verses.original: וָ֭אֹמַר אֶגְוָ֑ע עִם־ קִנִּ֣י אַרְבֶּ֥ה יָמִֽים׃ וְ֝כַח֗וֹל
verses.literal: So I thought I will die in my nest and multiply my days as the sand

verses.original: שָׁרְשִׁ֣י פָת֣וּחַ אֱלֵי־ מָ֑יִם וְ֝טַ֗ל יָלִ֥ין בִּקְצִירִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: šā·rə·šî p̄ā·ṯū·aḥ ’ĕ·lê- mā·yim wə·ṭal yā·lîn biq·ṣî·rî
verses.literal: My roots [will] spread out to the waters and the dew will rest nightly on my branches

verses.original: כְּ֭בוֹדִי חָדָ֣שׁ עִמָּדִ֑י וְ֝קַשְׁתִּ֗י תַחֲלִֽיף׃ בְּיָדִ֥י
verses.literal: My glory is [ever] new within me and my bow is renewed in my hand

verses.original: שָׁמְע֥וּ לִֽי־ וְיִחֵ֑לּוּ וְ֝יִדְּמ֗וּ לְמ֣וֹ עֲצָתִֽי׃
verses.literal: Men listened to me with expectation waiting silently for my counsel

verses.original: אַחֲרֵ֣י דְ֭בָרִי יִשְׁנ֑וּ לֹ֣א מִלָּתִֽי׃ תִּטֹּ֥ף וְ֝עָלֵ֗ימוֹ
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rê ḏə·ḇā·rî yiš·nū lō mil·lā·ṯî tiṭ·ṭōp̄ wə·‘ā·lê·mōw
verses.literal: After my words they spoke no more my speech settled on them like dew

verses.original: וְיִֽחֲל֣וּ כַמָּטָ֣ר לִ֑י פָּעֲר֥וּ וּ֝פִיהֶ֗ם לְמַלְקֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yi·ḥă·lū ḵam·mā·ṭār lî pā·‘ă·rū ū·p̄î·hem lə·mal·qō·wōš
verses.literal: They waited for me as for rain and drank in my words . . . like spring showers

verses.original: אֶשְׂחַ֣ק אֲ֭לֵהֶם לֹ֣א יַאֲמִ֑ינוּ וְא֥וֹר פָּ֝נַ֗י לֹ֣א יַפִּילֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: ’eś·ḥaq ’ă·lê·hem lō ya·’ă·mî·nū wə·’ō·wr pā·nay lō yap·pî·lūn
verses.literal: If I smiled at them they did not believe it the light of my countenance vvv was precious

verses.original: אֶֽבֲחַ֣ר דַּרְכָּם֮ וְאֵשֵׁ֪ב רֹ֥אשׁ וְ֭אֶשְׁכּוֹן כְּמֶ֣לֶךְ בַּגְּד֑וּד כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר יְנַחֵֽם׃ אֲבֵלִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: ’e·ḇă·ḥar dar·kām wə·’ê·šêḇ rōš wə·’eš·kō·wn kə·me·leḵ bag·gə·ḏūḏ ka·’ă·šer yə·na·ḥêm ’ă·ḇê·lîm
verses.literal: I chose their course and presided as chief So I dwelt as a king among his troops as a comforter . . . of the mourners
